user_prompt_summary: Create the general-purpose PDF Styler extension originally intended: arbitrary PDFs should resolve and follow reusable style presets rather than only the self-revising PDFs having styling rules.
target_improvement: Add extension.pdf_styler, a reusable style preset schema/registry, style.pdf.formats as the first preset, executable ReportLab adapter/validator, and verification integration.

candidate_decisions.reason: Existing style.formats_pdf is coupled to the recursive pair and does not provide a general style-resolution/application contract.

candidate_decisions.candidate: reuse Formats visual system as first named preset
candidate_decisions.reason: Preserves existing work while separating style tokens from recursive-system semantics.

candidate_decisions.candidate: hardcode one style into every PDF generator
candidate_decisions.reason: Would block explicit style choice and specialized approved generators; preset resolution is more reusable.

accepted_changes: Add executable pdf_styler.py loader/validator/ReportLab adapter and specimen renderer.
Enable PDF Styler in normal generation profiles while preserving specialized-generator overrides.
Add regression and PDF visual verification coverage.
rejected_or_noop: No requirement that every PDF look like Formats.pdf; it is the default named preset, not an immutable universal aesthetic.
No silent subjective style invention when a material style choice remains unresolved.
